name: Key Light Air MK.2

sources.title: Elgato Key Light Air MK.2 product page (Tech specs)
sources.covers: luminous flux, colour temperature range, panel dimensions, power consumption, mass

note: The page states "Up to 2,100 lumens (depending on power source)": the maximum, which a USB or battery supply may not reach. Panel 319 x 207 x 33 mm (W x H x D). The emitting face is taken as the whole front of the panel (an ASSUMPTION, as for the Key Light). CRI "> 94%" (not entered). Mass: "Weight 735 g | 1.62 lbs (light only)" (re-read 2026-11-07; an earlier reading had missed it). The page also gives the flux by power source: "~2100 lm" from a 27 W or larger supply, ~1270 lm from 20 W, ~750 lm from 15 W, ~400 lm from 7.5 W, ~180 lm under 7.5 W (the entry keeps the maximum). Not stated: luminance, beam profile, IR output. The page at this URL now describes the MK.2; the earlier Key Light Air is not entered.
